name: CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser
description: Foaming facial cleanser for normal to oily skin, designed to remove dirt and excess oil without disrupting the skin barrier.
benefits: Helps maintain the skin moisture barrier
usage: Massage onto wet skin and rinse with water.
cautions: Check the ingredient list on the purchased package before use.

name: Bioderma Sensibio H2O
description: Micellar cleansing water for removing makeup and impurities, designed with sensitive skin in mind.
usage: Follow the instructions on the product packaging.
cautions: Check the ingredient list on the purchased package before use.

name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%
description: Water-based serum targeting visible shine, uneven-looking texture and dullness.
benefits: Helps reduce the appearance of excess oil
usage: Apply a few drops in the morning and evening as directed by the brand.
cautions: Patch test before use and discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Baume B5+
description: Multi-purpose soothing balm for skin that needs moisture and barrier support.
usage: Apply to clean skin according to the product instructions.
cautions: Avoid the eye area and open wounds; check the package instructions.

name: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics SPF50+ PA++++
description: Daily sunscreen from Beauty of Joseon. The brand also uses the updated product name Relief Sun: Rice + Niacinamide for the same formula.
benefits: Provides broad-spectrum sun protection when used as directed
usage: Apply generously before sun exposure and reapply according to label instructions.
cautions: Check the local product label, ingredients and sun-protection directions.

name: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser
description: Low-pH gel cleanser designed to remove impurities while helping maintain the skin's natural balance.
benefits: Helps leave skin feeling clean without excessive dryness
usage: Lather a small amount with water, gently massage onto wet skin, and rinse thoroughly.
cautions: Avoid the eye area. Patch test before use and discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: Anua Heartleaf 77 Soothing Toner
description: A lightweight toner formulated with heartleaf extract to help soothe skin and provide lightweight hydration.
benefits: Helps soothe the look and feel of irritated skin
usage: After cleansing, apply an appropriate amount to the face with hands or a cotton pad.
cautions: Check the ingredient list on the purchased package before use. Patch test if you have sensitive skin.

name: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Ampoule
description: A lightweight centella ampoule designed to hydrate and help soothe skin.
usage: After cleansing and toning, apply a few drops to the face and gently pat until absorbed.
cautions: Check the ingredient list on the purchased package before use. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream
description: A rich moisturizer formulated to help hydrate dry skin and support the skin's protective barrier.
benefits: Helps support the skin moisture barrier
usage: Apply to clean skin as needed, following the product label.
cautions: Check the ingredient list on the purchased package before use.

name: Anessa Perfect UV Sunscreen Skincare Milk SPF50+ PA++++
description: A high-protection daily sunscreen milk designed to help protect skin from UV exposure.
benefits: Provides SPF50+ PA++++ sun protection when used as directed
usage: Shake if directed on the label, apply generously before sun exposure, and reapply according to package instructions.
cautions: Check the local product label, ingredients and sun-protection directions. Avoid contact with eyes.
